watch.summary: The streamer reacts with hands-on-head disbelief as a pro Valorant player turns around a round despite being spotted.

beats.what: Streamer starts clip yelling at chat before focusing back on the match.
Streamer watches the match footage intently as caster sets up the play.
The pro player hits an insane shot on mid.
Streamer grabs his head in utter shock yelling 'Oh my lord!'
Streamer questions how the player got the kill when everyone knew his position.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: Oh my lord! How? We literally knew where he was!
watch.why: The clip centers on esports hype and genuine amazement rather than comedic joke delivery. It appeals mostly to Valorant fans who understand the difficulty of the play being shown.
